items.exampleEn: The Olympics happen every four years.
My grandma likes to listen to opera.
The kids watch cartoons on TV.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們看電視上的卡通。
游泳是我最喜歡的運動。

items.exampleEn: The prince lives in a big palace.
items.exampleZh: 王子住在一座大宮殿裡。

items.sentenceEn: My son watches cartoons every morning.
items.sentenceZh: 我兒子每天早上看卡通。

items.audioEn: I like swimming, but my sister likes dancing.
items.audioZh: 我喜歡游泳，但我姊姊喜歡跳舞。
items.questionZh: 說話者的姊姊喜歡什麼？

items.sentenceEn: My daughter plays with her doll all day.
items.sentenceZh: 我女兒整天玩她的娃娃。

items.sentenceEn: We watched the Olympics on TV.

items.stemEn: This ____ has a talking cat and a funny dog.
items.stemZh: 這部卡通裡有一隻會說話的貓和一隻好笑的狗。

items.passageEn: Amy's family likes many things. Her grandmother loves opera. Her father watches the Olympics and loves swimming. Her little sister plays with dolls in pink dresses and watches cartoons. Amy likes dancing. Her favorite story is about a prince who dances at a big party.
items.passageZh: Amy 一家人喜歡很多東西。奶奶喜歡歌劇；爸爸看奧運，也很愛游泳；妹妹玩穿粉紅洋裝的洋娃娃、看卡通；Amy 喜歡跳舞。她最喜歡的故事是關於一位在盛大派對上跳舞的王子。

questions.questionZh: Amy 最喜歡的故事是關於什麼？
options: 一位在派對上跳舞的王子

referenceEn: My grandmother likes to listen to opera.
My grandma likes listening to opera.
rubricZh: 「聽歌劇」用 listen to opera（要有 to）
主詞是第三人稱單數，like 要加 s（例如 likes）

items.instructionZh: 用 swimming 造一個句子，說說你喜不喜歡游泳，或在哪裡游泳。
rubricZh: 「去游泳」用 go swimming（前面不加 to）
swimming 也可當主詞（例如 Swimming is fun）
